HOWTO.TITLE: How to play
HOWTO.BODY: Match the top card by colour, number or symbol — or play a Wild. Skip, Reverse and Draw Two change the turn; Wild Draw Four can be challenged if you think the player held a matching colour. No playable card? Draw one: play it if you can, otherwise pass. Empty your hand to score the cards left with everyone else (actions 20, Wilds 50). First to the target score wins.
